title: Jira Hierarchy - Development
description: Synthetic data only. Observations use a 30-day lookback; the timeline fits the fetched tickets' full lifetimes. Enter PM-200 or PM-300 in the panel's Parent control for alternate trees. UI changes are not persisted over provisioning updates.

panels.title: Jira Hierarchy
panels.description: Latest observation per source and issue, including cross-project descendants. A 10,001st row is retained as the maxIssues=10,000 warning sentinel.

targets.expr: {app="jira-panel-fixture", instance="demo", environment="development"} kind:="issue_state" | stats by (app, instance, environment, issue_key) row_max(_time) as row | unpack_json from row | fields _time, sync_ts, kind, app, instance, environment, issue_key, project_key, summary, issue_type, parent_key, issue_links, created_at, resolved_at, is_resolved, status, status_category, priority, assignee, company | sort by (issue_key) | limit 10001
